description:
Default way to read LinkedIn messages (standard and Sales Navigator), newest first. Without personUrl returns new messages across all conversations since inbox monitoring was enabled; requires sync_inbox (or nv_sync_inbox) once per account. With personUrl returns the whole known conversation with that person, including history loaded by sync_conversation, as { messages, threads }: each message also carries inboxMessageId (its id in the result without personUrl, or null) and threadId may be null; each thread carries historyFrom and historyComplete. Check threads[].historyComplete – if false and you need earlier messages, call sync_conversation once, then call get_inbox again. Every message carries personUrn — the permanent LinkedIn member URN (urn:li:member:<id>) of the person on the other side of the thread, or null when LinkedIn does not expose it. personHashedUrl is LinkedIn's hashed profile URL and is always present; personPublicUrl is the public vanity URL when that person has been resolved, otherwise null.

Linked API actions are queued into a cloud-browser workflow and may take several minutes. The server returns immediately after starting the workflow with {status: 'pending'|'running', pendingReason, workflowId, operationName, message}. To retrieve the final result, call get_workflow_result with the returned workflowId and operationName — it will long-poll until completion or the request budget elapses, then return either the final result or another in-progress snapshot. Do not retry the original tool while a workflow is still running; that creates duplicate queued work.

A pending workflow carries pendingReason: 'queued' means it is waiting its turn behind other work on the same account and will start within minutes. 'outsideWorkingHours' means the account has configured working hours and the workflow is parked until they reopen — possibly the next working day. In that case get_workflow_result returns immediately instead of polling, message states when the window opens, and you should report that to the user rather than looping.

personUrl.description: Optional LinkedIn URL of one person to get the whole known conversation with them instead of the whole inbox (e.g., 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/john-doe'). A hashed URL (personHashedUrl from a message) always matches; a public URL matches only once Linked API knows that person's public URL, so prefer personHashedUrl when messages from this person show personPublicUrl: null.

since.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp to only retrieve messages at or after this date (e.g., '2024-01-15T10:30:00Z'). If not provided, all captured messages are returned. Message times are whole minutes.

threadId.description: Optional conversation thread identifier to restrict the result to a single thread.

type.description: Optional inbox type filter: "st" for standard messages, "nv" for Sales Navigator messages. If omitted, both are returned.

name: get_inbox
